title: Hades II – Nintendo Switch 2 Edition
description: Hades II is Supergiant Games' action roguelike sequel starring Melinoë, Princess of the Underworld, in a battle against the Titan of Time. Runs are built around changing boons, weapons, encounters, permanent progression, and an expanding story. The Nintendo Switch 2 Edition adds higher-definition presentation and official performance support up to 120 fps in TV mode at 1080p and 60 fps in handheld mode at 1080p.

worldSummary: Melinoë fights through realms of Greek myth in a campaign against Chronos, supported by Olympian gods, witches, and figures from the Underworld.

storyChapters.title: The Titan of Time
storyChapters.body: Chronos has seized the House of Hades, and Melinoë trains under Hecate to challenge the Titan and free her family.

storyChapters.title: Nightly Descents
storyChapters.body: Each run sends Melinoë through changing regions where she receives boons, gathers resources, strengthens relationships, and expands her arsenal of witchcraft.

storyChapters.title: War Across Two Fronts
storyChapters.body: The conflict extends beyond the Underworld as Melinoë faces threats tied to Olympus and gradually uncovers the full scope of the war against Chronos.
